if: goods are removed for transportation in one of the four cases in rule 55(1)(a) to (d)
a delivery challan is issued in lieu of an invoice under rule 55(1)
then: for inter-State movement, the delivery challan MUST carry the place of supply
note: One mandatory particular of rule 55(1)(viii), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.
